sourceDelta.description: Remove the expired batch abort listener synchronously after capturing handlers and before awaiting the leading promise or invoking trailing work. Delayed completion no longer removes a listener attached by a newer batch.

verdict: Scoped repair supported; the demonstrated newly introduced cancellation regression is fixed and the original successful-leading behavior remains accepted.

independentReview.method: Reviewed repair-only source/test diff and original documented cancellation behavior, then examined original-native/private/posthoc receipt outputs. No repair code was edited by reviewer.

limitations: One bounded secondary repair attempt and targeted independent review; no proof of every debounce edge case or full lint/CI matrix.
